create_roundrobin_batch_iterator: create a RoundRobinBatchIterator that cycles batches from multiple BatchIterators in round-robin order
create_roundrobin_with_upsample: create a RoundRobinBatchIterator with upsample enabled to repeat shorter iterators until the longest completes
create_disjoint_multitask_handler: create a DisjointMultitaskDataHandler that wraps multiple DataHandlers for multitask training with round-robin iteration
get_train_iter_multitask: get a training batch iterator from a DisjointMultitaskDataHandler that round-robins across all task data handlers
init_metadata_multitask: initialize metadata across all sub data handlers in a DisjointMultitaskDataHandler and aggregate results
